questions.title: A few questions before we begin.
questions.body: This should take about five minutes. Your answers are saved as you go, so you can stop and return to this link at any time.

questions.title: Who is our main point of contact at {{customer}}?
What is the best email for them?
What would make this project a success?
questions.body: A sentence or two is plenty.

questions.title: How often would you like to hear from us?
How do you prefer to talk?
Is there a date this has to be done by?
Is there anything else we should know?

submit.title: That’s everything.
submit.body: Swipe back to review, or send your answers to us now.
submit.label: Send

outro.title: Thank you.
outro.body: We have everything we need from {{customer}} for now, and will be in touch shortly.
